description: This file implements security-related HTTP request functions, including IP deny list checks, URL validation, and secure HTTP/HTTPS fetch and axios requests with redirect validation.

methods.name: getHttpDenyList
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP deny list from environment variable or returns default list.

methods.name: isDeniedIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is in the deny list, throws error if denied.

methods.name: checkDenyList
methods.description: Validates if the hostname or its resolved IPs are in the deny list.

methods.name: secureAxiosRequest
methods.description: Performs an axios request with redirect validation against deny list.

methods.name: secureFetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with redirect validation against deny list.

methods.name: resolveAndValidate
methods.description: Resolves URL hostname to IP and validates against deny list.

methods.name: createPinnedAgent
methods.description: Creates an HTTP or HTTPS agent that binds to a specific IP address.
